text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Zimbabwean President Robert Mugabe said on Tuesday his government would continue to strengthen the fighting capacity and military preparedness of the country's defence force although it would never use the forces for aggressive purposes but to defend its interests and national sovereignty.

- About 10 Zimbabwean poverty-stricken rural communities will soon benefit from over Z$42 million being distributed under a poverty alleviation programme by the government and the United Nations Development Programme.
